title: The Plant with Many Jobs
intro: This quiz follows Lina and Mateo as they learn how the different parts of a plant work together.

questions.prompt: What are the two important jobs of a plant's roots?
choices: Absorbing water and minerals and holding the plant in place
Moving insects away from the plant
questions.explanation: Roots absorb water and minerals and hold the plant in place.

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Alvarez compare the stem to a delivery road?
choices: It carries water and food to different parts of the plant
It produces all the plant's seeds
It pulls sunlight into the soil
It protects the fruit from animals
questions.explanation: The stem carries water and food to different parts of the plant.

questions.prompt: What do leaves use to make food for the plant?
questions.explanation: Leaves use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make food for the plant.

questions.prompt: What is one important job of a flower?
choices: Holding the plant firmly in the soil
questions.explanation: One important job of a flower is helping the plant make seeds.

questions.prompt: How do fruits help a plant?
choices: They absorb water from the soil
They protect seeds and help spread them to new places
questions.explanation: Fruits protect seeds and help spread them to new places.
